# Three.js r180 runtime subset

Unmodified MIT-licensed upstream files from commit `0af9729d0c143a86a1d725d6e2c3ad83301f3f34` (r180), fetched through GitHub reads because direct npm DNS is unavailable. Local package.json is a deliberately restricted packaging manifest; this is not the full upstream npm package. No Minecraft textures are included.

Upstream: https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/tree/0af9729d0c143a86a1d725d6e2c3ad83301f3f34
